title: Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Net Metering Rooftop Solar PV Grid Interactive Systems) (Fifth Amendment) Regulations, 2025

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Substituted Reg 8(2) (connectivity level by Supply Code)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: The connectivity levels at which the Rooftop PV Solar System shall be connected with the grid shall be as per the supply voltage level provided under GERC (Electricity Supply Code and Related Matters) Regulations, 2015 as amended from time to time.

numeric_values.previous: Upto 6 kW 240 V single phase table

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: 1. Upto 6 kW 240 V- single phase 2. Above 6 kW and upto 18.65 kW 415 V-Three phase

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Reg 7 new proviso (no separate agreement for PM Surya Ghar)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: Provided that there shall not be requirement for execution of separate written connectivity agreement
